+## What
+Plan.md §8.6. In `Sources/FoundationModelsACPAgent/Agent/PromptTurn.swift` (+ a small `Cancellation.swift` if cleaner):
+
+- `session/cancel` is a notification. On receipt: answer every pending `session/request_permission` for that session with the **cancelled** outcome; stop the turn's work (Router queue-side cancellation — in-flight model turns run to completion until Router's in-flight cancellation lands upstream; that limitation is documented, not worked around); then send `state_update: idle` with `stopReason: "cancelled"` strictly last — any post-cancel updates go out **before** the idle update.
+- Send correct terminal tool statuses where we have them, but never hold the idle update waiting for them (§8.6).
+- Cancel of an idle session is a no-op (nothing pending, no error).
+- MCP `notifications/cancelled` is advisory — the honest result is "we stopped listening"; reflect that in the tool-call text for still-running detached calls.
+
+- [ ] Pending permission requests answered `cancelled`
+- [ ] Ordering: updates before the terminal idle
+- [ ] `idle` + `cancelled` terminator
+- [ ] Idle-session cancel no-op
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] A scripted turn blocked on `session/request_permission` + `session/cancel` → the permission promise resolves cancelled AND the last update is `idle(cancelled)`
+- [ ] No update of any kind arrives after the idle(cancelled) update
+- [ ] Cancelling an idle session produces no error and no state change
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentTests/CancellationTests.swift` — harness with a permission-blocking scripted turn; order assertions on the collector
+- [ ] `swift test` → green
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
